source.name: Sports.ru (Беттинг-индустрия): На новой форме «Краснодара» появился обновленный логотип Winline
source.quote: На передней части домашнего и гостевого комплекта размещен обновленный логотип букмекерской компании Winline.
source.note: Named press: the front of the kit carries the Winline logo; the same article says Winline is Krasnodar's title partner with a deal running to the end of the 2026/27 season. The Winline logo remains central on the front of the 2026/27 home shirt, worn in RPL play (club match galleries, e.g. Krasnodar–Akhmat, 15 August 2026, and Krasnodar–Akron, 13 September 2026, on fckrasnodar.ru).

source.name: FC Krasnodar: Ozon – официальный партнер ФК «Краснодар» (Ozon - official partner of FC Krasnodar)
source.quote: Логотип компании появится на игровой форме основной команды в новом сезоне РПЛ 2025/26.
source.note: Club announcement: the Ozon logo goes on the first team's playing kit and the partnership runs to 2029 (the stadium was renamed Ozon Arena on 1 May 2025). The Ozon wordmark sits on the upper chest of the 2026/27 home match shirt - club match photo galleries (Krasnodar–Akhmat, 15.08.2026: https://fckrasnodar.ru/team/photo/object/?object_id=153656; Krasnodar–Akron, 13.09.2026: https://fckrasnodar.ru/team/photo/object/?object_id=153995).

source.name: FC Krasnodar: Ozon – официальный партнер ФК «Краснодар» (Ozon - official partner of FC Krasnodar)
source.quote: Логотип компании появится на игровой форме основной команды в новом сезоне РПЛ 2025/26.
source.note: The Ozon wordmark appears below the back numbers on the 2026/27 home match shirt - club match photo gallery (Krasnodar–Akron, 13.09.2026, фоторепортаж: https://fckrasnodar.ru/team/photo/object/?object_id=153995). No sponsor above the players' names.

source.name: ABSTD (ABSEL distributor): ABSEL продолжает партнерство с ФК «Краснодар» в сезоне 2026/27 (ABSEL continues its partnership with FC Krasnodar in the 2026/27 season)
source.quote: бренд ABSEL продолжает официальное сотрудничество с футбольным клубом «Краснодар» в сезоне 2026/27
source.note: Company announcement that ABSEL is an official FC Krasnodar partner in 2026/27. The ABSEL wordmark is the upper of two logos on the right sleeve of the 2026/27 match shirt - club match photo gallery, Krasnodar–Akhmat, 15.08.2026: https://fckrasnodar.ru/team/photo/object/?object_id=153656.

source.name: FC Krasnodar official shop: Домашняя игровая футболка FCK 26/27 (home match jersey product page)
source.note: The club shop offers adding the Constell logo («Добавить логотип Constell») to the 26/27 home jersey. On the match-worn shirt the Constell wordmark is the lower of two logos on the right sleeve, below ABSEL - club match photo galleries (Krasnodar–Akhmat, 15.08.2026: https://fckrasnodar.ru/team/photo/object/?object_id=153656; Krasnodar–Akron, 13.09.2026: https://fckrasnodar.ru/team/photo/object/?object_id=153995). No named-press text source for the sleeve placement found.

summary: In-house 2026/27 home kit (launched 16 July 2026). Winline leads the front as title partner (deal to the end of 2026/27); Ozon's wordmark sits above it on the chest and below the back numbers (partnership to 2029, stadium renamed Ozon Arena); ABSEL and Constell wordmarks stack on the right sleeve. Left sleeve carries the league patch; shorts plain. All placements checked against the club's own match photo galleries.
